title: P-Image Upscale
summary: Upscale an image with P-Image Upscale
description: Pruna AI P-Image Upscale — fast image upscaling with results in seconds, up to 32 MP output. Priced by the target resolution tier: 4 MP = 10, 8 MP = 15, 16 MP = 30, 32 MP = 60 credits per image.

enhance_details.description: Enhance textures and fine detail (may increase contrast).

enhance_realism.description: Improve realism — recommended for AI-generated images.

image.description: Image to upscale. A public image URL, a data URI, raw base64, or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads.

output_format.description: Output format (jpg recommended; png files get very large at high megapixel targets).

target.description: Target output resolution in megapixels. Sets the price: 4 MP = 10, 8 MP = 15, 16 MP = 30, 32 MP = 60 credits.
